title: YuE2 Composition Studio
hero: Write the score. Hear the record. Keep every layer.
description: A private full-song studio for YuE2's native symbolic plan, semantic music, flow-matched acoustics, 48 kHz stereo decoder, and SheetSage2 cover pipeline.
guide: Every native stage is visible: write or reuse a score, retain exact plans, render multiple seeded candidates, inspect ABC invariants, transcribe recordings, and reopen complete project artifacts.
vram: 11–15 GiB measured native path · 24 GiB supported floor
runtime_contract: RTX 5090 · CUDA-only model compute · no CPU model offload · FIFO
residency: AR/NAR persistent CUDA · transient CUDA VAE

models.label: Krea planner (Qwen3-VL-4B)
models.note: Native Krea2 writing/planning checkpoint shared with the MiniMax studio; runs in its pinned runtime

models.label: Comfy YuE2 INT8
models.note: Preserved for the pinned Comfy workflow; native BF16 remains this studio's quality path

setup_steps: Start the private studio with `./startwithuv.sh`; it binds to `127.0.0.1:8270` unless explicitly changed in `.env.local`.
Use Create for a new full composition. Keep `full` planning when you want melody and chord editing; use `melody` for a cover that may change accompaniment.
Every render retains audio, ABC, exact plan arrays, semantic tokens, acoustic latents, effective config, weight identities, hashes, and a reusable `plan-bundle.zip`.
Use Compare for synchronized A/B playback and the animated lyric/spectrum room. Nothing is uploaded and no browser assets are fetched.

modes.title: Full white-box composition
modes.short: Compose a complete song and keep its editable melody-and-chord score.
modes.description: YuE2 writes a native two-voice ABC composition, generates semantic music, flow-matches acoustics, and decodes a 48 kHz stereo recording. Every intermediate survives.

modes.title: Plan direction (Krea)
modes.short: Write the musical direction first with the shared Krea2 writing model, then carry it into Create.
modes.description: Plans a song in the native Krea2 lane: structured Global Metadata / Vocal Details / Arrangement captions plus optional original or preserved lyrics. Runs job-scoped in the MiniMax studio's pinned Comfy runtime, identical to that studio's Prompt Guide, and hands the result back to Create.

options.label: Refine brief
options.description: Turn the brief into the three caption sections; supplied lyrics stay context only.

options.label: Keep my lyrics
options.description: Finish the captions around your finished lyrics, quoted verbatim and unchanged.

options.label: Draft song
options.description: Caption sections plus an original lyric draft with bracketed section tags.

options.label: Ask
options.description: Answer a music question directly; no caption headings required.

fields.label: Brief or question
fields.hint: Genre, mood, tempo, instruments, vocal character, exclusions, and section intent.

fields.label: Lyrics (finished or notes)
fields.hint: Required for Keep my lyrics; otherwise treated as data, never instructions.

fields.label: Research query
fields.hint: Only the query leaves the machine; lyrics never do.

modes.title: Melody-first composition
modes.short: Plan the vocal/instrumental melody while leaving accompaniment freer.
modes.description: Creates a chord-free native plan before rendering. Useful when the melody should be inspectable but the arrangement should retain latitude.

modes.title: Direct song generation
modes.short: Generate directly when an editable symbolic plan is not required.
modes.description: Uses YuE2's native `cot=off` instruction. The complete semantic, latent, config, identity, and audio record is still retained.

modes.title: Plan before rendering
modes.short: Write and inspect the score without committing GPU time to the final recording.
modes.description: Exports ABC, exact token IDs, prefix, integrity manifest, and a resumable plan bundle. Edit a copy or resume the untouched plan later.

modes.title: Recording → zero-shot cover
modes.short: Transcribe a source recording and reimagine it in one queued local workflow.
modes.description: SheetSage2 extracts an editable score with the pinned local MERT encoder; YuE2 realizes it with new lyrics and target production. Melody-only is recommended for a new arrangement.

fields.label: Harmony contract
fields.toggle_label: Keep source chord symbols and use full-score mode (off = melody-only/free accompaniment)

modes.title: Realize an ABC score
modes.short: Render a reviewed SheetSage2, YuE2, or hand-edited native score.
modes.description: Uses the supplied ABC as the exact symbolic prefix. Select full to retain harmony, or melody to let YuE2 create a new accompaniment.
modes.requires_any_message: Paste or upload an ABC score.

modes.title: Render an edited composition
modes.short: Reharmonize, change tempo/form, or adapt lyrics while preserving the source revision.
modes.description: Paste the reviewed edited ABC and render it as a new immutable project. Use Score Lab first when exact melody/meter invariants matter.
modes.requires_any_message: Paste or upload the edited ABC score.

modes.title: Inspect, compare & strip score
modes.short: Validate YuE2's exact dialect and prove melody/meter invariants before rendering.
modes.description: Inspects notes, ties, bar grids, keys, chords, and nominal duration. Optionally compare against an original or remove chords while preserving selected melodies.
modes.requires_any_message: Paste or upload the ABC score to inspect.
modes.preview_template: ABC structural check · strip chords: {{strip_chords}} · compare: {{compare_voices}}

modes.title: Recording → editable score
modes.short: Extract melody, chords, beats, key, structure, and optional representation tensors.
modes.description: Long songs use overlapping windows. Outputs include editable ABC, combined and separated MIDI, event JSON, and lab annotations; research tensors are opt-in.

modes.title: Resume an exact saved plan
modes.short: Continue from exact planner token IDs with integrity verification.
modes.description: Upload `plan-bundle.zip` from a prior Plan or Song output. YuE2 verifies every included file before semantic generation; edited scores belong in Realize or Edit instead.
modes.preview_template: Resume an integrity-checked exact symbolic plan

modes.title: Decode saved acoustic latents
modes.short: Re-decode a retained acoustic state without regenerating the composition.
modes.description: Loads only the local listening VAE on CUDA and preserves the natural output length. Useful for decoder checks and artifact recovery.
modes.preview_template: Decode retained YuE2 acoustic latents with {{vae_core_frames}}-frame CUDA tiles
